confirm.title: Link to Music Assistant
confirm.description: Listening Genome will build your listening profile from the Music Assistant integration **{ma_name}**. It stores only a reference to that entry, never its address or token.

pick.title: Choose a Music Assistant server
pick.description: More than one Music Assistant integration is set up. Choose the one whose listening history Listening Genome should use. Only a reference to it is stored, never its address or token.

error.ma_entry_missing: That Music Assistant entry no longer exists. Choose another.

abort.ma_not_configured: Listening Genome reads your history from Music Assistant, so the Music Assistant integration must be set up first. Add it under Settings > Devices & services, then add Listening Genome again.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Listening Genome is already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

init.title: Listening Genome settings
init.description: How the genome is computed, when it is refreshed, and where its history comes from. Saving reloads the integration; if a setting that changes the result was edited, the genome is rebuilt straight away.

data.enrich_enabled: Look up artists on MusicBrainz and ListenBrainz

data_description.recency_half_life_days: A listen this many days old counts half as much as one today. 0 turns recency weighting off. 0 to 3650.
data_description.obscurity_percentile: An artist counts as obscure when fewer ListenBrainz listeners have played them than this share of all artists.
data_description.min_seconds_played: Plays shorter than this are stored but not counted. 0 to 600.
data_description.rebuild_schedule_hour: The genome is recomputed once a day at this hour, in Home Assistant's time zone. 0 to 23.
data_description.enrich_enabled: Every hour, identify new artists on MusicBrainz (genres, era, country) and fetch their ListenBrainz popularity. Needs internet access.

lastfm.name: Last.fm
lastfm.description: Import your Last.fm scrobbles, then keep fetching new ones. Plays that Music Assistant or an Apple Music export already recorded are removed, so nothing counts twice. Get an API key at https://www.last.fm/api/account/create.

data_description.lastfm_username: Leave empty to stop using Last.fm (this also forgets the API key).
data_description.lastfm_api_key: 32 characters. Leave empty to keep the key already saved; it is never shown again after saving.
data_description.lastfm_poll_enabled: The first fetch imports your whole history, which can take several minutes. Later ones fetch only what is new.

error.lastfm_key_format: That does not look like a Last.fm API key: it should be 32 letters and digits. Copy it again from your Last.fm API account page.
error.lastfm_key_missing: Enter the API key that goes with this Last.fm username.
error.lastfm_poll_needs_account: Automatic fetching needs a Last.fm username and API key.
error.lastfm_rejected: Last.fm did not accept these details: {reason}
error.not_whole_number: Use whole numbers: days, seconds, hours and the polling interval cannot have decimals.

rebuild_failed.message: The listening genome could not be rebuilt: {error}

lastfm_not_configured.message: Last.fm is not set up. Add the username and API key in the Listening Genome settings first.

lastfm_already_running.message: A Last.fm import is already running.

path_not_allowed.message: Home Assistant may not read {path}. Put the file in /media or in your config folder.

import_lastfm.name: Import from Last.fm
import_lastfm.description: Fetch scrobbles from the Last.fm account in the settings: the whole history the first time, then only what is new. Runs in the background; rebuilds the genome afterwards if anything was added.

max_pages.name: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Stop after this many pages of 200 scrobbles. 0 fetches everything.

import_apple_csv.name: Import an Apple Music export
import_apple_csv.description: Import "Apple Music - Play History Daily Tracks.csv" (or "Play Activity") from an Apple data export. Runs in the background; rebuilds the genome afterwards if anything was added.

path.name: File
path.description: Full path to the CSV, in /media or your config folder.
